Before #230: ADR-0004 (and ADR-0006 since #83): a constant into a context or queue function is one context with one value (AtomicToQueue), so W was assumed k in Item 1 only
note: Three Orders, Item per Order. V is count(Constant{k}): the constant is one context with one value, so count is 1 in context 1 only and only Item 1 gets a V, as fn/constant/006. W is removeContexts(Constant{k}): PO keeps the constant form (the display queue shows k on a gray start row and a dark-gray end row, no white value row), so its result is a generating block and every Item gets W k, though V and W are siblings in one Item.
